title: Deskcity 0.1.0: first release
changes: One local hub for every AI worker you use: Claude, Gemini, OpenAI-style and local models, and coding agents such as Claude Code.
Give a job and pick who takes it next, on another model. Each step's model, tokens and cost are in the AI call log, and a finished job can be replayed step by step.
A monthly cap per worker, a score from 0 to 100 on every finished job, and one list, Waiting for you, for hires, questions and money warnings.
Four views of the same hub: 2D city, 3D city, Neural and plain pages.
AI helpers are off until you turn them on. Spending needs your dashboard password once you set one.
Nightly backups with a restore test, and updates that keep your data: npm run update.
Install on Windows by double-clicking install.cmd (Mac or Linux: bash install.sh), then start it with start.cmd (or bash start.sh).
New here? Run npm run demo to look around with no keys, or open this folder in Claude Code and say: set up my hub.
